input.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
input.reasoning_summary:
The claim states that NVIDIA's revenue for the quarter ended October 25, 2026 increased year over year. This would be the third quarter of fiscal year 2027 (FY2027 Q3).

The evidence provided includes:
- E1: 10-Q filed 2026-05-20 for period ending 2026-04-26 (FY2027 Q1)
- E2, E3, E6: 10-Q filed 2026-08-26 for period ending 2026-07-26 (FY2027 Q2)
- E4, E5: Also from the FY2027 Q1 filing

None of the evidence passages contain financial data for the quarter ended October 25, 2026 (FY2027 Q3). The latest period covered in the evidence is July 26, 2026 (FY2027 Q2). 

Evidence E5 shows revenue data for Q1 FY2027 ($81,615 million for Apr 26, 2026 vs $44,062 million for Apr 27, 2025), demonstrating year-over-year growth in Q1, but this does not provide information about Q3 FY2027.

Since the evidence does not include any 10-Q or 10-K filing covering the quarter ended October 25, 2026, there is insufficient evidence to verify whether revenue increased year over year for that specific period.
